description: MCP interface for the Distributed Modules topology. Provides tools for inspecting and validating distributed module configurations, resources for manifest and ruleset access, and prompts for distributed-governed implementation and extraction-readiness guidance.

tools.name: evolith-topology-inspect
tools.description: Inspect a Distributed Modules topology configuration and return its parsed manifest, service boundaries, and corpus artifact references.

configPath.description: Path to the Distributed Modules configuration file

includeServices.description: Include service boundary and communication metadata

tools.name: evolith-topology-validate
tools.description: Validate a Distributed Modules configuration against the topology ruleset and OPA policies, returning pass/fail per gate.

configPath.description: Path to the Distributed Modules configuration to validate

strictMode.description: Fail on warnings, not just errors

resources.name: Distributed Modules Topology Manifest
resources.description: Full topology manifest for Distributed Modules, including metadata, artifact references, and corpus configuration.

resources.name: Distributed Modules Rulesets
resources.description: All ruleset files for Distributed Modules: native rules JSON, OPA Rego policies, and WASM bundle.

prompts.name: topology-aware-implementation
prompts.description: Guides AI-assisted implementation to respect Distributed Modules topology constraints, network boundaries, and inter-service contracts.

prompts.name: extraction-readiness-review
prompts.description: Evaluates whether a module is ready for extraction into a distributed deployment, checking coupling, ownership, and contract boundaries.
